name: india-cea-grid-emission-factor-registry
title: Open registry of India's CEA grid emission factors, v1.0 to v22.0
description: A machine-readable version history of the Central Electricity Authority's CO2 Baseline Database for the Indian Power Sector: every factor in every published version (2006 to 2026), each traced to the workbook cell it came from, with the source URLs and SHA-256 hashes. A research dataset from a student project; not an official CEA product.
